task: Replace static KISA control statuses with live Kubernetes API evaluations, fix KISA-RBAC-02 rule scoring with exact acceptance, and add owner-approved minimal read-only portal RBAC

events.summary: Owner approved 'KISA 수정' (2026-11-24), including minimal read-only RBAC on ClusterRole narwhal-portal for live KISA controls and no new Secret read permission. Added list-only on security.istio.io/peerauthentications (KISA-TLS-01), wgpolicyk8s.io/policyreports (KISA-IMG-02), and cilium.io/{ciliumnetworkpolicies,ciliumclusterwidenetworkpolicies} (KISA-NET-01/ETCD-02; further read-only widening), plus get/list on batch/cronjobs (KISA-SEC-01 get and KISA-IMG-02 list); no secrets rule was added.

Before this change, live measurement through kubectl proxy showed 6 static KISA controls (KISA-SEC-01/ETCD-02/IMG-01 fail, KISA-TLS-01/OBS-01/IMG-02 warn) with stale descriptions and KISA-RBAC-02 over-reporting 6 Critical bindings due to cross-rule wildcard combination and ignored apiGroups.
evidence: test:kubectl proxy (admin kubeconfig) getKisaControls() before -> pass 6, fail 6, warn 4, manual 0 (6 static controls, KISA-RBAC-02 Critical 6)

test:kubectl auth can-i as system:serviceaccount:devtools:narwhal-portal -> no for security.istio.io/peerauthentications, batch/cronjobs, wgpolicyk8s.io/policyreports, cilium.io/ciliumnetworkpolicies, storage secrets; yes for networkpolicies, deployments, statefulsets, replicasets, pods, clusterpolicies, and monitoring AlertmanagerConfig/narwhal-notification-channels

events.summary: Closed round-7 and round-8 closed-world gaps: (1) Canonicalizer audit (`kisa-policy-canonical.mjs`) hashing all top-level fields outside explicit non-semantic allow-list {apiVersion, kind, metadata, status} (covering both spec and specs[] on CiliumNetworkPolicy/CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy and unknown future fields), plus empty default-deny podSelector assertion in gen-kisa-policy-baseline.mjs; (2) ETCD-02 workload identity (`etcd02Workload`) and exact `matchesLabelSelector` verification against running template labels (no `{app:'apisix-etcd'}` fallback; mismatch => warn 'reviewed policy does not select the running etcd pods') and `ciliumPolicySelectsLabels` covering both `spec` and `specs[]`; (3) Read-only `list` on `cilium.io/ciliumclusterwidenetworkpolicies` on ClusterRole narwhal-portal + `clusterwidePolicies` baseline (`allow-ambient-kubelet-probes`) enforced in both ETCD-02 and NET-01 (warn 'unreviewed cluster-wide policy present' / 403 => manual), plus known-limits paragraph in `docs/common/compliance-hardening.md`.
